$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHM (AIP France, chart dated 2017-07-20): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Megève

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD with special caracteristics, reserved for rated pilots: for ACFT pilots, hold mountain qualification (wheels or/and skis), or site authorization of altiport in validity.; for ULM pilots, it is strongly recommended to take mountain course organized by FFPLUM.
Unmarked telepheric cables near from entering circuit and RWY.
ACFT: Only one departure sector available.
Respect flying circuits due to the moutains and the environment.
Avoid overflying the farms downstream the mountain aerodrome 200 m from RWY.
Unusable outside RWY and PRKG platform.
